question: What security and ownership boundary should the Dashboard browser preview use before implementation?
rationale: The requested panel would expose sensitive browser state and may be implemented either as core Control UI or through a plugin UI surface; automation cannot choose that product/security boundary safely.

options.title: Read-only-first admin panel
options.body: Add a first-party or approved plugin-contributed panel that shows tabs, URL/title, screenshots, and logs by default while requiring explicit user steps for navigation, clicks, credentials, and submit actions.

options.title: Wait for plugin UI entry points
options.body: Defer the browser panel until the generic plugin UI entry-point contract lands and then implement the browser surface as plugin-owned UI under that contract.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the current CLI/RPC screenshot workflow and pause the panel request until remote-browser preview becomes a prioritized product area.

recommendation.title: Read-only-first admin panel
recommendation.body: Add a first-party or approved plugin-contributed panel that shows tabs, URL/title, screenshots, and logs by default while requiring explicit user steps for navigation, clicks, credentials, and submit actions.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from browser runtime/docs history and the existing issue discussion about keeping this tracker open.
